verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's own AI assistant, Rico, answers plain-language billing questions such as MRR drops directly from platform data. Its MCP server lets AI assistants work with the platform without the dashboard, but the evidence describes it as managing apps, Products and Entitlements, not querying metrics. Missing for 10: evidence that an agent can query delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, or a customer's invoices; evidence that the MCP server or REST API exposes MRR and other metrics to the user's own agent; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: Instead of digging through charts and tables yourself, you can ask Rico plain-language questions like "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?" and get a direct, data-driven answer.
The RevenueCat MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enables AI assistants to manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard.
